baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins seeing, the shirt, a longitudinal tear, and its rear location.
baseline_models.mechanism: A worn covering retains a directional rupture: its rearward longitudinal damage converts an absent struggle into inspectable material testimony.

activation_trace.role: Ocular perception makes the garment's condition available as evidence.
The worn covering supplies a surface capable of retaining a bodily encounter.
The longitudinal slit makes the damage directional rather than generic.
The back locates the applied force behind the wearer and gives the trace its orientation.

changed_reading.before: He notices a damaged shirt and then accuses.
changed_reading.after: He reads rearward longitudinal damage as a nonverbal witness to relative movement and agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The shirt is torn from the back rather than merely described as damaged.
baseline_models.mechanism: The garment's branch of leaping and instability, joined to rearward cutting and turning one's back, lets the shirt function as a frozen motion diagram of escape and pursuit.

activation_trace.role: Leaping and bodily instability animate the shirt as a recorder of disturbed motion.
A lengthwise opening supplies the drawn track of force across the moving covering.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the flightward vector carried by the tear.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is a static exhibit.
changed_reading.after: The shirt is a frozen kinetic trace: its disturbed covering and rearward slit preserve the direction of flight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Sight is followed by speech, doubled mention of plot, and the predicate 'great.'
baseline_models.mechanism: A local material indication is verbalized and then enlarged into a categorical judgment; evidentiary inference and rhetorical amplification coexist in the same utterance.

activation_trace.role: Direct sight supplies the local observation from which the verdict begins.
A thing's capacity to indicate is transferred into speech, letting the material trace effectively 'say' something.
Repeated intrigue turns a single inferred act into the named mechanism of the verdict.
The image of the major or greater part scales the local inference toward a broad category.

changed_reading.before: The speaker simply identifies a trick.
changed_reading.after: The speaker converts one visible trace into a magnified class judgment, so sound inference and generalizing rhetoric must be kept distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier interpretation, judgment, and distinguishing-mark cues reactivate the focus as a compact adjudicative hermeneutic: one reasons backward from an aftermath to the unseen action that produced it.

activation_trace.role: Looking to an affair's consequence turns the literal rear into a retrospective inferential posture.
Discriminating and separating affairs turns the cut into an instrument of adjudicative distinction.
Return to outcome supplies the logic of reconstructing an event from what it came to.
Judgment between people frames the inspection as adjudication rather than bare noticing.
A distinguishing trace supplies the epistemic role assigned to the tear.

structural_cues: The sequence places interpretation in 12:21 and judgment with knowledge in 12:22 before the household dispute.
The focus orders perception before pronouncement, exposing a miniature sign-to-verdict procedure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interpretation, judgment, a distinguishing mark, and rearward damage; I supply the arrow from aftermath to prior cause. A live alternative is that these cues characterize broader preparation without making this speaker's inference exemplary.

changed_reading.before: The rear tear is an obvious clue.
changed_reading.after: The rear tear is read by a retrospective adjudicative method: the outcome is separated into signs and returned to its most plausible prior cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: The move from sealed interior to raced-for threshold gives the focus tear a topology: the wearer is oriented outward while restraint acts from behind.

activation_trace.role: Instability and leaping let the garment register hurried bodily motion.
Turning one's back supplies the outward withdrawal encoded by the rear tear.
Coercive closure supplies the constricted interior from which escape must occur.
The entryway becomes the spatial boundary between confinement and exit.
Racing supplies the opposed motion that stretches the encounter toward the threshold.
The repeated doorway fixes both the destination of flight and the site where the parties are found.

structural_cues: Closed doors in 12:23 are followed by a race to the door and a rear tear in 12:25.
The repeated threshold brackets the chase and prevents the rear location from being an isolated detail.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, racing, threshold, and rear damage; I assign the directional arrow of outward flight with force applied from behind. Scrambling at the threshold remains possible, but it does not erase the rearward vector.

changed_reading.before: The tear's location merely selects the truthful claimant.
changed_reading.after: The tear maps an escape route from coercive enclosure: destination ahead, pursuer and restraining force behind.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior sequence of seeing proof and averting harm pairs with seeing the shirt and redirecting judgment; vision repeatedly functions as a pivot that turns a course away from a false or harmful trajectory.

activation_trace.role: The focus sight initiates the second perceptual turning point.
The earlier act of seeing supplies a parallel perceptual pivot.
Established proof gives the earlier sight its directive evidentiary force.
Turning something from its course supplies the functional result shared by the paired visions.

structural_cues: 12:24 and 12:28 each place seeing before a decisive redirection.
The first redirection concerns conduct; the second concerns the direction of accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two sight events, proof, and explicit aversion; I infer a repeated sight-to-turning pattern. The alternative is that the two visions differ too sharply in source and authority to form more than a narrative echo.

changed_reading.before: The focus inspection is an isolated forensic observation.
changed_reading.after: The inspection is the second sight-mediated reversal: proof turns conduct in one scene and a material sign turns accusation in the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding paired condition makes garment geometry operate like testimony: front and back are competing causal models whose observed orientation sorts truth from falsehood.

activation_trace.role: The covering becomes the shared physical exhibit on which the conditional test operates.
A witnessing sign authorizes a material mark to perform evidentiary work.
Face-to-face orientation supplies the rejected causal model of frontal encounter.
Truth of speech names one output of the directional test.
Contradiction of truth names the paired adverse output.
Rear orientation supplies the observed condition that selects between the rival accounts.
Established soundness supplies the positive status assigned after the rear condition.

structural_cues: 12:26 and 12:27 explicitly oppose front and rear before 12:28 reports the observed rear condition.
Truth and falsehood switch sides with the tear's orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a two-case test and its observed result; I treat the garment's geometry as nonverbal witness. The test supports the relative claims, but it need not validate every part of the speaker's later generalization.

changed_reading.before: The husband recognizes an intuitive clue.
changed_reading.after: He executes the result of an explicit two-hypothesis test in which the garment's orientation testifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verdict recognizes the sign but does not liberate the innocent party: immediate instructions contain the affair, and later sight of the signs is followed by imprisonment. Epistemic success and institutional consequence separate.

activation_trace.role: The material sign's indication reaches explicit verbal acknowledgment.
Turning aside converts acknowledged truth into a policy of containment.
Covering the offense and shielding its agent shifts resolution from public adjudication to managed aftermath.
A newly appearing opinion supplies the later policy reversal despite prior recognition.
Seeing confirms that the signs were perceptually available to the decision makers.
Visible marks generalize the shirt from one clue into a recognized field of signs.
Confinement supplies the institutional outcome that overrides the signs' exculpatory force.

structural_cues: The focus verdict is followed immediately by an order to turn away in 12:29.
In 12:35 the decision to imprison comes explicitly after the signs have been seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acknowledgment, containment language, seen signs, and imprisonment; I infer household and institutional management overriding evidentiary consequence. The prison decision may also answer wider social pressure rather than deny the sign itself.

changed_reading.before: Seeing the rear tear resolves the accusation.
changed_reading.after: Seeing resolves knowledge but not power: the truth is recognized, contained, and ultimately made compatible with imprisoning the exonerated person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plural address in the focus expands through a city network of saying and hearing. 'Your plot' can name not only coordinated action but a discourse circuit that produces a collective category as accusation circulates.

activation_trace.role: The repeated pluralized intrigue supplies the collective category whose formation needs explanation.
Speech spreading among people supplies the transmission mechanism that enlarges a private affair.
The group of women gives the earlier plural a concrete social body.
The gathered city supplies the scale at which household speech becomes public discourse.
Audible circulation and public repute close the loop by returning the women's speech to the household.

structural_cues: A plural judgment in 12:28 is followed by city women speaking in 12:30 and their speech being heard in 12:31.
The affair moves from household inspection to public repetition and back into a staged household response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural language and a say-hear circulation sequence; I infer that circulation helps constitute the collective to which plotting is attributed. The plural may instead refer only to immediate addressees and acquire wider resonance later.

changed_reading.before: The plural is a fixed stereotype applied to an already defined group.
changed_reading.after: The plural is also socially produced: repeated speech carries the private accusation outward and returns it as collective pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later staged sight event echoes the focus sequence: seeing leads to magnification, cutting, and categorical speech. The echo preserves the rear tear's evidentiary value while exposing how perception can also generate bodily shock and verbal overreach.

activation_trace.role: The focus sight supplies the first perception-to-verdict sequence.
Awe and inward magnification keep open an affective register within the word of greatness.
Something present and prepared marks the later visual encounter as deliberately staged.
The women's sight initiates the echoed perception-to-reaction sequence.
Magnifying something inwardly provides an explicit counterpart to the focus predicate of greatness.
Severing and incision move the focus's cut from clothing onto the spectators' bodies.
Attributing what is not literally the case supplies the categorical excess of the post-sight declaration.
The angel category supplies the later utterance's overt leap beyond ordinary human classification.

structural_cues: Both 12:28 and 12:31 use a when-they-saw progression followed by material or bodily cutting and categorical speech.
The second progression is explicitly prepared before the object of sight appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated syntax, magnification, cutting, and angelic classification; I use the later echo to qualify the earlier leap from sign to class. The focus verdict remains more materially grounded, so the parallel destabilizes its scope rather than its core exoneration.

changed_reading.before: Sight in the focus transparently yields a complete verbal truth.
changed_reading.after: Sight yields valid evidence but can also trigger magnification and categorical excess; the later staged echo warns against equating exoneration with the full generalization.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later command, prison threat, humiliation, counterfactual inclination, and divine redirection operationalize the plot's greatness as coercive force upon agency, not clever concealment alone.

activation_trace.role: Severe handling supplies a force-bearing sense for the repeated plot.
Magnitude and strength provide the scale later measured by coercive effects.
Protective restraint marks the resistance required against the pressure.
Demand and obligation turn covert maneuver into an overt command.
Confinement supplies the concrete sanction attached to refusal.
Humiliation adds social degradation to the carceral threat.
The repeated term carries the focus diagnosis into a stated pressure on the subject's agency.
Inclination of the heart supplies the possible internal yielding produced by external pressure.
The split-root image of the heart pouring toward desire intensifies the same live risk without collapsing mapped identities.
Counter-turning shows that the pressure is neutralized by an opposed directional force.

structural_cues: The focus's adjective is followed by a threat combining command, prison, and humiliation in 12:32.
In 12:33 the plot is linked to possible inclination unless diverted, and 12:34 supplies that diversion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sanctions, resistance, possible inclination, and counter-turning; I treat these as an operational measure of the plot's greatness. The adjective can still primarily characterize deception at the focus moment.

changed_reading.before: The plot is great because it is ingenious or deceptive.
changed_reading.after: The plot is great because it couples desire, command, status power, and confinement strongly enough to threaten the direction of another person's will.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a skin/surface branch from a context occurrence whose immediate lexical use is different. It remains anchored in the shirt as bodily covering, its cut, and the later cut hands; downstream prose should call it a branch-activated material analogy, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cut falls on the worn covering that lies at the body's surface.

activation_trace.role: The garment as covering lets cloth occupy the body's exposed boundary.
The slit marks that proxy surface with the force that might otherwise reach flesh.
Visible skin and surface supply the cross-domain image that makes the covering legible as an outer bodily layer.
Later incision transfers cutting from proxy covering to actual bodies.
The bodily hands specify where the later cut is directly inscribed.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is only external evidence.
changed_reading.after: The shirt momentarily acts as proxy skin, bearing the encounter's wound before the later spectacle writes cutting directly onto hands.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from the speech root to littleness, so it is form-distant and must not be presented as the word's lexical meaning. It remains anchored in the focus utterance's explicit greatness contrast; downstream prose should frame it only as a rhetorical scale activation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The utterance magnifies the plot while reducing a concrete dispute to a collective formula.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of smallness activates diminution within the act of saying.
The repeated intrigue supplies the object elevated by the utterance.
Explicit magnitude supplies the opposing scale against which diminution becomes rhetorically visible.

changed_reading.after: As an exploratory scale effect, the sentence enlarges 'plot' while shrinking individual agents and circumstances into a compact collective label.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-scene material reversal, not a claim that the shirt literally cancels the earlier sale. It remains anchored because the same objectified person's covering carries a truth-bearing trace after concealment and undervaluation; downstream prose should retain the analogy as exploratory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A possessed garment attached to the formerly traded person becomes the material that resists a false account.

activation_trace.role: The personal covering supplies a material object still attached to the wearer's embodied history.
Concealment in the interior supplies the earlier suppression of the person's visible identity.
A piece of capital made into merchandise supplies the earlier material classification imposed on him.
Exchange through sale supplies the transactional movement that objectifies the person.
Diminution of due value sharpens the earlier reduction against which the truth-bearing garment reverses function.

changed_reading.before: The shirt is one more material possession in a story of ownership.
changed_reading.after: Materiality reverses function: the covering of the concealed, undervalued commodity becomes a counter-document that restores his account.

strongest_changes: The rear tear became both a kinetic escape map and a conditional material witness.
Interpretation, judgment, and distinguishing-mark cues made the focus a retrospective adjudicative procedure rather than bare seeing.
The later staged sight-cut-speech echo preserved exoneration while exposing rhetorical magnification and category overreach.
Seen signs did not produce release; household containment and later imprisonment separated knowledge from institutional power.
The plot's greatness became measurable as coercive pressure on agency through command, humiliation, prison, inclination, and counter-turning.
summary.what_was_special: The compact sight-shirt-cut-back-speech chain supported several coexisting mechanisms: forensic discrimination, escape topology, retrospective interpretation, social circulation, visual hyperbole, and coercive force. Later repetitions of sight, cutting, speech, and plot both strengthened and destabilized the focus verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The rearward geometry strongly supports pursuit, but the exact bodily sequence at the threshold remains inferred.
It remains open whether 'great' primarily measures deceptive skill, coercive power, affective awe, or rhetorical enlargement.
The plural may address an immediate group before becoming a city-wide discourse category.
The proxy-skin, inverse-scale, and anti-commodity readings are branch-driven analogies and should not be promoted to lexical claims.
